content: कुसुम्भः, -म्भम् [<ls>Uṇ. 4. 106</ls>] .²1 Safflower; कुसुम्भारुणं चारु चेलं वसाना <ls>Jag.</ls>; कुसुम्भरागारुणितैः सुदुकुलैः <ls>Ṛs. 6. 4</ls>. .²2 Saffron. .²3 The waterpot of an ascetic; <ls>Ms. 6. 52</ls>. .{@-म्भम्@} Gold. .{@-म्भः@} Mere outward affection (compared with the colour of safflower); hence कुसुम्भरागः also means affected love.
